content:
Wenzhou Longchang Chemical Co., Ltd. is a prominent chemical manufacturing and distribution enterprise located in the Lantian Industrial Zone of Yongzhong Town, Longwan District, Wenzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China. Strategically situated within one of the region’s key industrial hubs, the company benefits from excellent transportation links and a robust industrial ecosystem, enabling efficient production, logistics, and collaboration with domestic and international partners. Since its establishment, Wenzhou Longchang Chemical has focused on the research, development, production, and commercialization of a wide range of specialty chemical products that serve diverse industries such as textiles, coatings, plastics, electronics, and water treatment.

The company places a strong emphasis on innovation, quality control, and environmental responsibility, adhering to stringent national and international standards in its manufacturing processes. Equipped with advanced production facilities and staffed by a team of experienced chemists and engineers, Wenzhou Longchang Chemical is committed to delivering high-performance, reliable, and sustainable chemical solutions tailored to meet the evolving needs of its clients. The company also prioritizes safety and eco-friendly practices, ensuring compliance with Chinese environmental regulations and promoting green chemistry principles.

With a customer-centric approach and a reputation for reliability, Wenzhou Longchang Chemical has built strong relationships across global markets. Through continuous investment in R&D and process optimization, the company positions itself as a trusted partner in the chemical industry, contributing to industrial advancement and sustainable development both regionally and internationally.
